title: Collections
subtitle: Money recorded in the field. Posted means the ERP has accepted it.
conflictsSubtitle: Field collections the ERP did not accept. Resolve each one; nothing is dropped silently.
emptyBody: Try a wider date range or remove a filter.
voidDesc: Only collections not yet posted to the ERP can be voided. The collector's cash on hand is reduced and the audit log records your reason.

actionHelp.post_to_plan: Post this money against the plan you choose in the ERP.
actionHelp.post_as_advance: Keep the money on the customer's account as an advance.
actionHelp.retry_post: Send it to the ERP again unchanged (for temporary errors).
actionHelp.refund: The money goes back to the customer. A photo of the refund proof is required.
actionHelp.void: The money was not actually collected.

noConflictsBody: Every field collection in this branch was accepted by the ERP.
rule: Resolving posts or reverses money in the ERP. It is not undoable here.

proof.label: Refund proof
proof.help: A photo of the refund slip signed by the customer, or of the money handed back. A refund cannot be confirmed without it.

errors.notImage: Only a picture can be used.
errors.tooBig: The photo could not be brought under 1 MB. Use another one.
errors.unreadable: This picture format cannot be read. Use a JPEG photo.

conflictHint.DUPLICATE_SAME_DAY: The ERP takes one payment per installment invoice per day. Post it to another plan or as an advance, or refund it. If the office allows a second payment that day, retry posting.
conflictHint.COLLECTOR_NOT_LINKED: {{name}} is not linked to an ERP employee. Link them, then retry posting.
conflictHint.METHOD_NOT_AVAILABLE: The office has to add this payment method for the branch in the ERP first, then retry posting. Otherwise refund it.
conflictHint.PLAN_CLOSED: The invoice was returned or cancelled. Post the money to another plan of this customer, or refund it.

collectDesc: Record a payment collected from a customer. No device location is required from the admin panel.
